en.text: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.

zhSimplified.text: 挪亚的儿子闪、含、雅弗的后代记在下面。洪水以后，他们都生了儿子。

zhTraditional.text: 挪亞的兒子閃、含、雅弗的後代記在下面。洪水以後，他們都生了兒子。

en.text: The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

zhSimplified.text: 雅弗的儿子是歌篾、玛各、玛代、雅完、土巴、米设、提拉。

zhTraditional.text: 雅弗的兒子是歌篾、瑪各、瑪代、雅完、土巴、米設、提拉。

en.text: The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

zhSimplified.text: 歌篾的儿子是亚实基拿、利法、陀迦玛。

zhTraditional.text: 歌篾的兒子是亞實基拿、利法、陀迦瑪。

en.text: The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

zhSimplified.text: 雅完的儿子是以利沙、他施、基提、多单。

zhTraditional.text: 雅完的兒子是以利沙、他施、基提、多單。

en.text: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.

zhSimplified.text: 这些人的后裔将各国的地土、海岛分开居住，各随各的方言、宗族立国。

zhTraditional.text: 這些人的後裔將各國的地土、海島分開居住，各隨各的方言、宗族立國。

en.text: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

zhSimplified.text: 含的儿子是古实、麦西、弗、迦南。

zhTraditional.text: 含的兒子是古實、麥西、弗、迦南。

en.text: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.

zhSimplified.text: 古实的儿子是西巴、哈腓拉、撒弗他、拉玛、撒弗提迦。拉玛的儿子是示巴、底但。

zhTraditional.text: 古實的兒子是西巴、哈腓拉、撒弗他、拉瑪、撒弗提迦。拉瑪的兒子是示巴、底但。

en.text: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one on the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 古实又生宁录，他为世上英雄之首。

zhTraditional.text: 古實又生寧錄，他為世上英雄之首。

en.text: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD”.

zhSimplified.text: 他在耶和华面前是个英勇的猎户，所以俗语说：「像宁录在耶和华面前是个英勇的猎户。」

zhTraditional.text: 他在耶和華面前是個英勇的獵戶，所以俗語說：「像寧錄在耶和華面前是個英勇的獵戶。」

en.text: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

zhSimplified.text: 他国的起头是巴别、以力、亚甲、甲尼，都在示拿地。

zhTraditional.text: 他國的起頭是巴別、以力、亞甲、甲尼，都在示拿地。

en.text: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,

zhSimplified.text: 他从那地出来往亚述去，建造尼尼微、利河伯、迦拉，

zhTraditional.text: 他從那地出來往亞述去，建造尼尼微、利河伯、迦拉，

en.text: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.

zhSimplified.text: 和尼尼微、迦拉中间的利鲜，这就是那大城。

zhTraditional.text: 和尼尼微、迦拉中間的利鮮，這就是那大城。

en.text: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

zhSimplified.text: 麦西生路低人、亚拿米人、利哈比人、拿弗土希人、

zhTraditional.text: 麥西生路低人、亞拿米人、利哈比人、拿弗土希人、

en.text: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.

zhSimplified.text: 帕斯鲁细人、迦斯路希人、迦斐托人；从迦斐托出来的有非利士人。

zhTraditional.text: 帕斯魯細人、迦斯路希人、迦斐託人；從迦斐託出來的有非利士人。

en.text: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,

zhSimplified.text: 迦南生长子西顿，又生赫

zhTraditional.text: 迦南生長子西頓，又生赫

en.text: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,

zhSimplified.text: 和耶布斯人、亚摩利人、革迦撒人、

zhTraditional.text: 和耶布斯人、亞摩利人、革迦撒人、

en.text: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,

zhSimplified.text: 希未人、亚基人、西尼人、

zhTraditional.text: 希未人、亞基人、西尼人、

en.text: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.

zhSimplified.text: 亚瓦底人、洗玛利人、哈马人，后来迦南的诸族分散了。

zhTraditional.text: 亞瓦底人、洗瑪利人、哈馬人，後來迦南的諸族分散了。

en.text: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.

zhSimplified.text: 迦南的境界是从西顿向基拉耳的路上，直到迦萨，又向所多玛、蛾摩拉、押玛、洗扁的路上，直到拉沙。

zhTraditional.text: 迦南的境界是從西頓向基拉耳的路上，直到迦薩，又向所多瑪、蛾摩拉、押瑪、洗扁的路上，直到拉沙。

en.text: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.

zhSimplified.text: 这就是含的后裔，各随他们的宗族、方言，所住的地土、邦国。

zhTraditional.text: 這就是含的後裔，各隨他們的宗族、方言，所住的地土、邦國。

en.text: Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.

zhSimplified.text: 雅弗的哥哥闪，是希伯子孙之祖，他也生了儿子。

zhTraditional.text: 雅弗的哥哥閃，是希伯子孫之祖，他也生了兒子。

en.text: The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.

zhSimplified.text: 闪的儿子是以拦、亚述、亚法撒、路德、亚兰。

zhTraditional.text: 閃的兒子是以攔、亞述、亞法撒、路德、亞蘭。

en.text: The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

zhSimplified.text: 亚兰的儿子是乌斯、户勒、基帖、玛施。

zhTraditional.text: 亞蘭的兒子是烏斯、戶勒、基帖、瑪施。

en.text: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.

zhSimplified.text: 亚法撒生沙拉；沙拉生希伯。

zhTraditional.text: 亞法撒生沙拉；沙拉生希伯。

en.text: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.

zhSimplified.text: 希伯生了两个儿子，一个名叫法勒，因为那时人就分地居住；法勒的兄弟名叫约坍。

zhTraditional.text: 希伯生了兩個兒子，一個名叫法勒，因為那時人就分地居住；法勒的兄弟名叫約坍。

en.text: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

zhSimplified.text: 约坍生亚摩答、沙列、哈萨玛非、耶拉、

zhTraditional.text: 約坍生亞摩答、沙列、哈薩瑪非、耶拉、

en.text: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

zhSimplified.text: 哈多兰、乌萨、德拉、

zhTraditional.text: 哈多蘭、烏薩、德拉、

en.text: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

zhSimplified.text: 俄巴路、亚比玛利、示巴、

zhTraditional.text: 俄巴路、亞比瑪利、示巴、

en.text: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

zhSimplified.text: 阿斐、哈腓拉、约巴，这都是约坍的儿子。

zhTraditional.text: 阿斐、哈腓拉、約巴，這都是約坍的兒子。

en.text: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.

zhSimplified.text: 他们所住的地方是从米沙直到西发东边的山。

zhTraditional.text: 他們所住的地方是從米沙直到西發東邊的山。

en.text: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.

zhSimplified.text: 这就是闪的子孙，各随他们的宗族、方言，所住的地土、邦国。

zhTraditional.text: 這就是閃的子孫，各隨他們的宗族、方言，所住的地土、邦國。

en.text: These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these on the earth after the flood.

zhSimplified.text: 这些都是挪亚三个儿子的宗族，各随他们的支派立国。洪水以后，他们在地上分为邦国。

zhTraditional.text: 這些都是挪亞三個兒子的宗族，各隨他們的支派立國。洪水以後，他們在地上分為邦國。
